correctness.rationale: The explicit gluing is the cited k=1 construction; t=x^2/z is a uniformizer and the class t^-3 is Serre-dual nonzero. Inverting the fiber transition gives b_q = sum binom(q-1,j-1) f_j t^(3j-2q). All five proposed finite jets have holomorphic W expansions, because t^3 z = x^6/f5(x) = x + O(1). Higher corrections exist by H^1(C,O(qp))=0 for q>=3. The precise degree-five cancellation and nonzero order-six coefficient -z are verified. The Weierstrass semigroup explicitly generates the whole graded algebra by six classes, and the filtered lifting lemma gives edim<=5. The source lower bound gives edim>=5. The attached checker confirms finite algebraic components but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Embedding dimension is the natural minimal ambient dimension of a normal surface singularity and determines whether it belongs to the codimension-two versus codimension-three setting of Wahl-type conjectures. The current primary literature explicitly leaves only a lower bound for its genus-two nonlinear family; proving sharpness by a structural five-generator filtered cancellation settles a well-motivated precise invariant for every smooth genus-two Weierstrass model, not an arbitrary parameter slice. This does not claim to settle broader conjectures.
